layout_note: ICSE 2025 CDFUZZ / assisting-exploration study artifact. Bundles CDFuzz (AFL fork), per-benchmark seed corpora, demo jhead workflow, and build-bench.sh to compile real-world fuzz targets. Benchmark binaries are NOT prebuilt.
copy_note: The shared artifact is read-only. Copy fuzzer sources or build scripts into project/ before modifying. Write compiled targets, fuzz output, and metrics under project/ or results/.

instance_counts.note: Git clone is ~15 MB. Full evaluation requires building all 21 programs (Experiment/build-bench.sh plus extra targets), installing 9 fuzzers + CDFUZZ, and running 21×10×24h×5 campaigns — expect multi-GB disk for builds and thousands of CPU-hours.

python_environment.note: Prepared at container startup. LLVM-13, clang, AFL++, and build-essential are on PATH.

toolchain.cdfuzz_build: make && make -C llvm_mode inside CDFuzz/ with LLVM_CONFIG=llvm-config-13

not_provided.prebuilt_benchmark_binaries: Agent must compile all targets with afl-clang-fast (extend build-bench.sh as needed).
not_provided.prebuilt_fuzzer_binaries: Agent must clone, build, and configure all nine studied fuzzers plus CDFUZZ from upstream sources.
not_provided.fuzzingdriver_dictionaries: Agent must generate dictionaries via FuzzingDriver or an equivalent automated LLVM/CodeQL pipeline.
